current_official_findings.source: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents ArcGIS layer
current_official_findings.verified: Layer 0 is a polygon feature layer in EPSG:27700 with JSON/geoJSON/PBF query support and fields filename, os_ref, flight dates, transform, geoid, filepath, latest and polygon_id.
National programme index is EPSG:27700 and exposes tilename, DTM filename, flight dates, surveys, resolution, year, supplied and latest fields.
Point geometry can be supplied as x,y; inSR specifies the input CRS; default spatial relationship is intersects; returnGeometry=false is supported.

current_official_findings.source: OGC API Features Core and Filtering
current_official_findings.verified: Core supports feature discovery/query and bbox/datetime; Part 3 publishes Queryables and richer CQL2 filtering; non-WGS84 CRS requires the relevant CRS capability rather than assumption.
OpenData download route supports productId, format, subformat, area and redirect; TQ is valid; 200 is JSON list and 307 only for one exact redirect match.
Version Date July 2026, all Great Britain, ASCII Grid/GML Grid available.
Current distribution item points to official api.os.uk using product identifier Terrain50 and the /products/Terrain50/downloads route.
